title: Qualify observations using resolved policy
description: Define a policy-driven observation qualification boundary that currently refuses all derivation because no approved physical policy exists; once genuinely unblocked, it may consume only qualifying physical-provenance observations.
acceptanceCriteria: Absent or unresolved physical policy returns a blocked result before examining values for derivation
Demo, synthetic, software-artifact, malformed, incompatible, and policy-insufficient observations are excluded with structured reasons
No prototype constant or task fixture acts as an evidence threshold
The contract requires an explicit versioned approved policy before a qualifying result is possible

steps.details: Require a versioned approved policy reference covering provenance, sample requirements, diagnostics, thresholds, and correction rules from resolved source issues.
Return the TASK-102 gate refusal while policy is absent and do not embed fallback thresholds or synthetic defaults.
Model future qualifying and refused outcomes with source observation IDs, policy version, incompatibilities, exclusions, and stable reasons.
Verify missing policy, demo-only, synthetic, one-sample, mixed, and incompatible fixtures cannot produce qualifying observations today.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; define the boundary and current blocked tests, not a derivation algorithm.

PHYSICAL BLOCKERS (source issues, not generated task IDs): issue 13 must establish available materials, issue 07 must establish a repeated-observation baseline, and issue 09 must establish evidence thresholds and correction policy.
BLOCKED: implementation of a successful qualification path awaits real physical evidence and approved policy from issues 13, 07, and 09.
Do not claim policy or qualifying observations exist.
